verses.sloka: कृत्वा एवम् उदकम् तस्मै प्रस्थितौ राघवौ तदा ।अवेक्षन्तौ वने सीताम् जग्मतुः पश्चिमाम् दिशम् ॥३-६९-१॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtvā evam udakam tasmai prasthitau rāghavau tadā ।avekṣantau vane sītām jagmatuḥ paścimām diśam ॥3-69-1॥

translations.english: Rama and Lakshmana offered libations (for Jatayu) and went westward, looking for Sita in the forest.
translations.hindi: अरश्यकाएड का उनहत्त रवाँ सर्ग पूरा हुआ , [० रा० अ०--३५ सप्ततितमः सग: मरी > 22.4 तौ तु तत्र स्थितौ दृष्टा श्रातरों रामलक्ष्मणौ । बाहुपाशपरिक्षिप्तो कबन्धो वाक्यमब्रवीत्‌

verses.sloka: ताम् दिशम् दक्षिणाम् गत्वा शर चाप असि धारिणौ ।अविप्रहतम् ऐक्ष्वाकौ पन्थानम् प्रतिपेदतुः ॥३-६९-२॥
verses.transliteration: tām diśam dakṣiṇām gatvā śara cāpa asi dhāriṇau ।aviprahatam aikṣvākau panthānam pratipedatuḥ ॥3-69-2॥

translations.english: Wielding bow, arrows and sword, both the princes of the Ikshvaku race went southward and entered an untrodden (densely wooded) tract.
translations.hindi: अरे क्षत्रियश्रेष्ठ ! मुझे देख तुम दोनों जन डरे हुए से कमरों खड़े हो! सुक भूखे के आहार के लिए विधाता ने तुमको मेरे पास भेज दिआ हे

verses.sloka: गुल्मैः वृक्षैः च बहुभिः लताभिः च प्रवेष्टितम् ।आवृतम् सर्वतो दुर्गम् गहनम् घोर दर्शनम् ॥३-६९-३॥
verses.transliteration: gulmaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ ca bahubhiḥ latābhiḥ ca praveṣṭitam ।āvṛtam sarvato durgam gahanam ghora darśanam ॥3-69-3॥

translations.english: It was a dense, impenetrable and dreadful forest covered with shrubs, trees and creepers spread all over.
translations.hindi: कवन्ध के ये बचन सुन, लक्ष्मण जी दुःखित हो और अपना बल अज्ञमाने सा निश्चय कर, समयानुकूल श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से 'बोले

verses.sloka: व्यतिक्रम्य तु वेगेन गृहीत्वा दक्षिणाम् दिशम् ।सु भीमम् तन् महाअरण्यम् व्यतियातौ महाबलौ ॥३-६९-४॥
verses.transliteration: vyatikramya tu vegena gṛhītvā dakṣiṇām diśam ।su bhīmam tan mahāaraṇyam vyatiyātau mahābalau ॥3-69-4॥

translations.english: The two mighty heroes swiftly forged through the great forest, which was an abode of serpents and lions.

verses.sloka: ततः परम् जनस्थानात् त्रि क्रोशम् गम्य राघवौ ।क्रौंच अरण्यम् विविशतुः गहनम् तौ महौजसौ ॥३-६९-५॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ param janasthānāt tri krośam gamya rāghavau ।krauṁca araṇyam viviśatuḥ gahanam tau mahaujasau ॥3-69-5॥

translations.english: Both the mighty princes of the Raghu dynasty covered a distance of three krosas from Janasthana and entered the impassable kraunchaforest.
translations.hindi: देखो, यह राक्षसाधम हम दोनों को पकड़े हुए हे । अतः हम दोनों इसकी ये दोनों बड़ी भारी भुजाएं काट दाल 0 0 पाठान्तरे पकर 77 ।” कक १ लत र सृप्र 0 श्‌} ; भीषणोऽयं महाकायो राक्षसो भुजविक्रम; । लोक ह्यतिजितं कृत्या ह्यावां हन्तुमिहेच्छति

verses.sloka: नाना मेघ घन प्रख्यम् प्रहृष्टम् इव सर्वतः ।नाना वर्णैः शुभैः पुष्पैः मृग पक्षि गणैः युतम् ॥३-६९-६॥
verses.transliteration: nānā megha ghana prakhyam prahṛṣṭam iva sarvataḥ ।nānā varṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ mṛga pakṣi gaṇaiḥ yutam ॥3-69-6॥

translations.english: Tormented due to abduction of Sita, the two princes anxious to see her searched all over the dense forest stopping here and there on the way. The thick forest looked like a conglomeration of big clouds. It was filled with different kinds of birds, snakes and animals.
translations.hindi: है राघव ! यज्ञ में वलि देने के लिए लाए गए बकरों की तरह चेष्टा रहित मरना चत्रियां के लिए बड़ी निन्दा की बात है

verses.sloka: दिदृक्षमाणौ वैदेहीम् तत् वनम् तौ विचिक्यतुः ।तत्र तत्र अवतिष्ठन्तौ सीता हरण दुःखितौ ॥३-६९-७॥
verses.transliteration: didṛkṣamāṇau vaidehīm tat vanam tau vicikyatuḥ ।tatra tatra avatiṣṭhantau sītā haraṇa duḥkhitau ॥3-69-7॥

translations.english: Tormented due to abduction of Sita, the two princes anxious to see her searched all over the dense forest stopping here and there on the way. The thick forest looked like a conglomeration of big clouds. It was filled with different kinds of birds, snakes and animals.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों की इस प्रकार की बातचीत सुन, राक्षस क्रुद्ध दो अपना भयङ्कर मुँह फेला, उन दोनों को खाने के लिए तैयार हुआ

verses.sloka: ततः पूर्वेण तौ गत्वा त्रि क्रोसम् भ्रातरु तदा ।क्रौंचारण्यम् अतिक्रम्य मातंग आश्रम अंतरा ॥३-६९-८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pūrveṇa tau gatvā tri krosam bhrātaru tadā ।krauṁcāraṇyam atikramya mātaṁga āśrama aṁtarā ॥3-69-8॥

translations.english: Then both the sons of Dasaratha, went further east, crossed the kraunchaforest after three krosas. They saw a dreadful forest which was full of fierce animals and birds near the hermitage of sage Matanga. It was densely covered with trees. They saw there a cave perpetually enveloped in darkness which was as deep as the netherworld.
translations.hindi: तब देश और काल के जानने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र ओर लक्ष्मण अपनी अपनी तलवारों से उसकी बाह्र सहज में कन्धे से काट डाली

verses.sloka: दृष्टा तु तद् वनम् घोरम् बहु भीम मृग द्विजम् ।नाना वृक्ष समाकीर्णम् सर्वम् गहन पादपम् ॥३-६९-९॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭā tu tad vanam ghoram bahu bhīma mṛga dvijam ।nānā vṛkṣa samākīrṇam sarvam gahana pādapam ॥3-69-9॥

translations.english: Then both the sons of Dasaratha, went further east, crossed the kraunchaforest after three krosas. They saw a dreadful forest which was full of fierce animals and birds near the hermitage of sage Matanga. It was densely covered with trees. They saw there a cave perpetually enveloped in darkness which was as deep as the netherworld.

verses.sloka: ददृशाः ते गिरौ तत्र दरीम् डशरथ आत्मजौ ।पाताल सम गम्भीराम् तमसा नित्य संवृताम् ॥३-६९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: dadṛśāḥ te girau tatra darīm ḍaśaratha ātmajau ।pātāla sama gambhīrām tamasā nitya saṁvṛtām ॥3-69-10॥

translations.english: Then both the sons of Dasaratha, went further east, crossed the kraunchaforest after three krosas. They saw a dreadful forest which was full of fierce animals and birds near the hermitage of sage Matanga. It was densely covered with trees. They saw there a cave perpetually enveloped in darkness which was as deep as the netherworld.
translations.hindi: भुज्ञाओं के काटते हो महाबाहु कबन्ध, मेघ की तरह भयङ्कर शब्द कर और अपने उस भयङ्कर शब्द से आकाश, प्रथवी तथा समस्त दिशाओं को पूरित करता हुआ, भूमि पर गिर पड़ा

verses.sloka: आसाद्य च नरव्याघ्रौ दर्याः तस्या अविदूरतः ।ददर्श तु महारूपाम् रक्षसीम् विकृत आननाम् ॥३-६९-११॥
verses.transliteration: āsādya ca naravyāghrau daryāḥ tasyā avidūrataḥ ।dadarśa tu mahārūpām rakṣasīm vikṛta ānanām ॥3-69-11॥

translations.english: Both the princes,the best among men, reached the cave and saw a huge demoness with a disfigured face not far from the cave.
translations.hindi: दोनों भुजाओं के कटने से अपने शरीर को रुघिर से लस्त- यस्त देख और दीन हो, दानब कंबध ने पूछा, तुम दोनों युवक कौन हो ?

verses.sloka: भयदाम् अल्प सत्त्वानाम् भीभत्साम् रौद्र दर्शनाम् ।लंबोदरीम् तीक्ष्ण दंष्ट्राम् करालीम् परुष त्वचम् ॥३-६९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: bhayadām alpa sattvānām bhībhatsām raudra darśanām ।laṁbodarīm tīkṣṇa daṁṣṭrām karālīm paruṣa tvacam ॥3-69-12॥

translations.english: Then the two brothers saw a fearful demoness who could strike terror in the mind of the timid, an uncouth figure with huge curved skins, with a big stomach, dishevelled hair, sharp and long teeth, devouring wild animals.
translations.hindi: इस प्रश्न के उत्तर में शुभ लक्षणों से युक्त लक्ष्मण, कबन्ध को, श्रीरामचन्द्र का परिचय देते हुए, कहने लगे

verses.sloka: भक्षयन्तीम् मृगान् भीमान् विकटाम् मुक्त मूर्धजाम् ।अवैक्षताम् तु तौ तत्र भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-६९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayantīm mṛgān bhīmān vikaṭām mukta mūrdhajām ।avaikṣatām tu tau tatra bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-69-13॥

translations.english: Then the two brothers saw a fearful demoness who could strike terror in the mind of the timid, an uncouth figure with huge curved skins, with a big stomach, dishevelled hair, sharp and long teeth, devouring wild animals.

verses.sloka: सा समासाद्य तौ वीरौ व्रजन्तम् भ्रातुः अग्रतः ।एहि रंस्यावहे इति उक्त्वा समालंबत लक्ष्मणम् ॥३-६९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: sā samāsādya tau vīrau vrajantam bhrātuḥ agrataḥ ।ehi raṁsyāvahe iti uktvā samālaṁbata lakṣmaṇam ॥3-69-14॥

translations.english: She came close to them, held Lakshmana who was walking ahead of his brother and said Come, let us enjoy.
translations.hindi: हि बा 02 कु श्रीराम के नाम से संसार में असिद्ध हछ। में इनका छोटा भाई हूँ ओ चमण त्यती हैँ और मेरा नाम लद [मात्रा प्रतिहते राज्ये राम; प्रवाजितो वनम । मया सह चरत्येष भा्यया क च महद्वनम्‌ ]

verses.sloka: उवाच च एनम् वचनम् सौमित्रिम् उपगुह्य सा ।अहम् तु अयोमुखी नाम लाभः ते त्वम् असि प्रियः ॥३-६९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca enam vacanam saumitrim upaguhya sā ।aham tu ayomukhī nāma lābhaḥ te tvam asi priyaḥ ॥3-69-15॥

translations.english: Taking hold of Saumitri the demoness said 'I am Ayomukhi and I have been obtained by you. You got me, O hero, O lord For the rest of your life you will sport with me on the lofty hills and river banks.'
translations.hindi: इन देवतुल्य प्रभावशाली श्रीरासचन्द्र की पत्नी को, इस बिजन बन में रहने के समय, एक राक्षस हर कर ले गया है। इसोको खाजते हम लोग यहाँ आए हैं

verses.sloka: नाथ पर्वत दुर्गेषु नदीनाम् पुलिनेषु च ।आयुः चिरम् इदम् वीर त्वम् मया सह रंस्यसे ॥३-६९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: nātha parvata durgeṣu nadīnām pulineṣu ca ।āyuḥ ciram idam vīra tvam mayā saha raṁsyase ॥3-69-16॥

translations.english: Taking hold of Saumitri the demoness said 'I am Ayomukhi and I have been obtained by you. You got me, O hero, O lord For the rest of your life you will sport with me on the lofty hills and river banks.'
translations.hindi: यह तो बतलाओ कि, तुम कौन हो और किस विए कवन्ध | को तरह और अपनी छाती में चम वमाता. मुख लगाए, जंघारहित ' हो इस निजन बन में लोट रहे हो

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु कुपितः खडगम् उद्धृत्य लक्ष्मणः ।कर्ण नास स्तनम् तस्या निचकर्ता अरिसूदनः ॥३-६९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu kupitaḥ khaḍagam uddhṛtya lakṣmaṇaḥ ।karṇa nāsa stanam tasyā nicakartā arisūdanaḥ ॥3-69-17॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Lakshmana, subduer of enemies, became angry, took out the sword and cut off her ears, nose and breasts.

verses.sloka: कर्ण नासे निकृत्ते तु विस्वरम् विननाद सा ।यथा आगतम् प्रदुद्राव राक्षसी घोर दर्शना ॥३-६९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: karṇa nāse nikṛtte tu visvaram vinanāda sā ।yathā āgatam pradudrāva rākṣasī ghora darśanā ॥3-69-18॥

translations.english: When the ears and nose of the frightening demoness were cut off she shouted in a fierce tone and ran away in the direction she had come from.
translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण जी का वचन सुन, वह राक्षस हर्षित हो और इन्द्र की ' केही बात को स्मरण कर, कहने लगा ।!१७॥ स्वागतं वां नरव्याघ्रौ दिष्ट्या पश्यामि चाप्यहम्‌ । दिष्ट्या चेमौ निकृत्तौ मे युवाभ्यां बाइुबन्धनौ

verses.sloka: तस्याम् गतायाम् गहनम् व्रजन्तौ वनम् ओजसा ।आसेदतुः अरि मित्र घ्नौ भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-६९-१९॥
verses.transliteration: tasyām gatāyām gahanam vrajantau vanam ojasā ।āsedatuḥ ari mitra ghnau bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-69-19॥

translations.english: The destroyers of enemies, Rama and Lakshmana of great valour went through the dense forest after she ran away.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणः तु महातेजाः सत्त्ववान् शीलवान् शुचिः ।अब्रवीत् प्रांजलिः वाक्यम् भ्रातरम् दीप्त तेजसम् ॥३-६९-२०॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇaḥ tu mahātejāḥ sattvavān śīlavān śuciḥ ।abravīt prāṁjaliḥ vākyam bhrātaram dīpta tejasam ॥3-69-20॥

translations.english: Lakshmana of great brilliance and power, of good conduct and pure character spoke to his highly effulgent brother with folded hands:

verses.sloka: स्पंदन्ते मे दृढम् बाहुः उद्विग्नम् इव मे मनः ।प्रायशः च अपि अनिष्टानि निमित्तानि उपलक्षये ॥३-६९-२१॥
verses.transliteration: spaṁdante me dṛḍham bāhuḥ udvignam iva me manaḥ ।prāyaśaḥ ca api aniṣṭāni nimittāni upalakṣaye ॥3-69-21॥

translations.english: My arm is throbbing heavily. My mind is agitated. The omens I see foretell some undesirable events.

verses.sloka: तस्मात् सज्जी भव आर्य त्वम् कुरुष्व वचनम् हितम् ।मम एव हि निमित्तानि सद्यः शंसन्ति संभ्रमम् ॥३-६९-२२॥
verses.transliteration: tasmāt sajjī bhava ārya tvam kuruṣva vacanam hitam ।mama eva hi nimittāni sadyaḥ śaṁsanti saṁbhramam ॥3-69-22॥

translations.english: O noble brother be alert. Heed my words of good advice. The bad omens I see presage perils.

verses.sloka: एष वंजुलको नाम पक्षी परम दारुणः ।आवयोः विजयम् युद्धे शंसन् इव विनर्दति ॥३-६९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa vaṁjulako nāma pakṣī parama dāruṇaḥ ।āvayoḥ vijayam yuddhe śaṁsan iva vinardati ॥3-69-23॥

translations.english: This vanchulaka bird's loud and dreadful screams suggest our triumph in war.

verses.sloka: तयोः अन्वेषतोः एवम् सर्वम् तत् वनम् ओजसा ।संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दः प्रभंजन् इव तत् वनम् ॥३-६९-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ anveṣatoḥ evam sarvam tat vanam ojasā ।saṁjajñe vipulaḥ śabdaḥ prabhaṁjan iva tat vanam ॥3-69-24॥

translations.english: As both the brothers with great prowess were searching for Sita all over, a huge sound exploded as if shattering the forest.

verses.sloka: संवेष्टितम् इव अत्यर्थम् गहनम् मातरिश्वना ।वनस्य तस्य शब्दो अभूत् दिवम् आपूरयन् इव ॥३-६९-२५॥
verses.transliteration: saṁveṣṭitam iva atyartham gahanam mātariśvanā ।vanasya tasya śabdo abhūt divam āpūrayan iva ॥3-69-25॥

translations.english: It appeared as though a fierce wind rose from the forest and filled the sky.

verses.sloka: तम् शब्दम् कांक्षमाणः तु रामः खड्गी सह अनुजः ।ददर्श सु महा कायम् राक्षसम् विपुल उरसम् ॥३-६९-२६॥
verses.transliteration: tam śabdam kāṁkṣamāṇaḥ tu rāmaḥ khaḍgī saha anujaḥ ।dadarśa su mahā kāyam rākṣasam vipula urasam ॥3-69-26॥

translations.english: While looking for the sound, Rama with his brother saw a demon with a huge body and a big belly.

verses.sloka: आसेदतुः च तत् रक्षः तौ उभौ प्रमुखे स्थितम् ।विवृद्धम् अ-शिरो ग्रीवम् कबंधम् उदरे मुखम् ॥३-६९-२७॥
verses.transliteration: āsedatuḥ ca tat rakṣaḥ tau ubhau pramukhe sthitam ।vivṛddham a-śiro grīvam kabaṁdham udare mukham ॥3-69-27॥

translations.english: Then both the brothers saw a very tall figure with a trunk that stood facing them. He had neither neck nor head. His face was in the stomach.

verses.sloka: रोमभिर्निश्चितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महागिरिमिवोच्छ्रितम् - यद्वा -रोमभिः निचितैः तीक्ष्णैः महागिरिम् इव उच्छ्रितम् ।नील मेघ निभम् रौद्रम् मेघ स्तनित निःस्वनम् ॥३-६९-२८॥
verses.transliteration: romabhirniścitaistīkṣṇairmahāgirimivocchritam - yadvā -romabhiḥ nicitaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ mahāgirim iva ucchritam ।nīla megha nibham raudram megha stanita niḥsvanam ॥3-69-28॥

translations.english: With sharp bristled hair all over the body, he was a mammoth figure who looked like a mountain resembling a dark cloud with his voice like the thunder.

verses.sloka: अग्नि ज्वाल निकाशेन ललाटस्थेन दीप्यता ।महापक्षेण पिंगेन विपुलेन आयतेन च ॥३-६९-२९॥
verses.transliteration: agni jvāla nikāśena lalāṭasthena dīpyatā ।mahāpakṣeṇa piṁgena vipulena āyatena ca ॥3-69-29॥

translations.english: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

verses.sloka: एकेन उरसि घोरेण नयनेन आशु दर्शिना ।महा दंष्ट्र उपपन्नम् तम् लेलिहानम् महा मुखम् ॥३-६९-३०॥
verses.transliteration: ekena urasi ghoreṇa nayanena āśu darśinā ।mahā daṁṣṭra upapannam tam lelihānam mahā mukham ॥3-69-30॥

translations.english: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

verses.sloka: भक्षयंतम् महा घोरान् ऋक्ष सिम्ह मृग द्विपान् ।घोरौ भुजौ विकुर्वाणम् उभौ योजनम् आयतौ ॥३-६९-३१॥
verses.transliteration: bhakṣayaṁtam mahā ghorān ṛkṣa simha mṛga dvipān ।ghorau bhujau vikurvāṇam ubhau yojanam āyatau ॥3-69-31॥

translations.english: The terrific demon kept eating bears, lions, deer and elephants, catching with both his arms stretching up to one yojana.

verses.sloka: कराभ्याम् विविधान् गृह्य ऋक्षान् पक्षि गणान् मृगान् ।आकर्षन्तम् विकर्षन्तम् अनेकान् मृग यूथपान् ॥३-६९-३२॥
verses.transliteration: karābhyām vividhān gṛhya ṛkṣān pakṣi gaṇān mṛgān ।ākarṣantam vikarṣantam anekān mṛga yūthapān ॥3-69-32॥

translations.english: He stood rooted there, catching bears, flocks of birds and deer with both his hands stretching up to one yojana, pulling and pushing them. (Now) he obstructed the path of the two brothers.

verses.sloka: स्थितम् आवृत्य पन्थानम् तयोः भ्रात्रोः प्रपन्नयोः ।अथ तम् समतिक्रम्य क्रोश मात्रम् ददर्शतुः ॥३-६९-३३॥
verses.transliteration: sthitam āvṛtya panthānam tayoḥ bhrātroḥ prapannayoḥ ।atha tam samatikramya krośa mātram dadarśatuḥ ॥3-69-33॥

translations.english: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.

verses.sloka: महान्तम् दारुणम् भीमम् कबंधम् भुज संवृतम् ।कबंधम् इव संस्थानत् अति घोर प्रदशनम् ॥३-६९-३४॥
verses.transliteration: mahāntam dāruṇam bhīmam kabaṁdham bhuja saṁvṛtam ।kabaṁdham iva saṁsthānat ati ghora pradaśanam ॥3-69-34॥

translations.english: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.

verses.sloka: स महा बाहुः अत्यर्थम् प्रसार्य विपुलौ भुजौ ।जग्राह सहितौ एव राघवौ पीडयन् बलात् ॥३-६९-३५॥
verses.transliteration: sa mahā bāhuḥ atyartham prasārya vipulau bhujau ।jagrāha sahitau eva rāghavau pīḍayan balāt ॥3-69-35॥

translations.english: The longarmed demon spread his hands and caught hold of Rama and Lakshmana together by pressing them with all his force.

verses.sloka: खड्गिनौ दृढ धन्वानौ तिग्म तेजौ महा भुजौ ।भ्रातरौ विवशम् प्राप्तौ कृष्यमाणौ महा बलौ ॥३-६९-३६॥
verses.transliteration: khaḍginau dṛḍha dhanvānau tigma tejau mahā bhujau ।bhrātarau vivaśam prāptau kṛṣyamāṇau mahā balau ॥3-69-36॥

translations.english: The two mighty brothers who wielded swords and strong bows and whose bodies were of fiery splendour became helpless, seized by the hands of Kabandha.

verses.sloka: तत्र धैर्यात् च शूराः तु राघवो न एव विव्यधे ।बाल्यात् अनाश्रयत्वात् च एव लक्ष्मणः तु अतिविव्यधे ॥३-६९-३७॥
verses.transliteration: tatra dhairyāt ca śūrāḥ tu rāghavo na eva vivyadhe ।bālyāt anāśrayatvāt ca eva lakṣmaṇaḥ tu ativivyadhe ॥3-69-37॥

translations.english: Of the two heroes, Rama being courageous was not worried but Lakshmana being younger and not having as much courage, was very much concerned and depressed. He said to Rama:

verses.sloka: उवाच च विषण्णम् सन् राघवम् राघव अनुजः ।पश्य माम् विवशम् वीर राक्षसस्य वशम् गतम् ॥३-६९-३८॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca viṣaṇṇam san rāghavam rāghava anujaḥ ।paśya mām vivaśam vīra rākṣasasya vaśam gatam ॥3-69-38॥

translations.english: O heroic Rama see how helpless I am under the control of the demon. Set yourself free, leaving me alone and using me as an offering.

verses.sloka: मया एकन तु निर्युक्तः परिमुच्यस्व राघव ।माम् हि भूत बलिम् दत्त्वा पलास्व यथा सुखम् ॥३-६९-३९॥
verses.transliteration: mayā ekana tu niryuktaḥ parimucyasva rāghava ।mām hi bhūta balim dattvā palāsva yathā sukham ॥3-69-39॥

translations.english: Giving me to this monstor as an offering, you may run away happily. I think you will soon obtain Vaidehi.

verses.sloka: अधिगंता असि वैदेहीम् अचिरेण इति मे मतिः ।प्रति लभ्य च काकुत्स्थ पितॄ पैतामहम् महीम् ॥३-६९-४०॥
verses.transliteration: adhigaṁtā asi vaidehīm acireṇa iti me matiḥ ।prati labhya ca kākutstha pitṝ paitāmaham mahīm ॥3-69-40॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, on getting the hereditary kingdom and ruling over it you should always remember me.

verses.sloka: तत्र माम् राम राज्यस्थः स्मर्तुम् अर्हसि सर्वदा ।लक्ष्मणेन एवम् उक्तः तु रामः सौमित्रिम् अब्रवीत् ॥३-६९-४१॥
verses.transliteration: tatra mām rāma rājyasthaḥ smartum arhasi sarvadā ।lakṣmaṇena evam uktaḥ tu rāmaḥ saumitrim abravīt ॥3-69-41॥

translations.english: O valiant Lakshmana, a hero like you should not get desparate. said Rama to Saumitri when he was thus entreated by Lakshmana.

verses.sloka: मा स्म त्रासम् वृथा वीर न हि त्वा दृक् विषीदति ।एतस्मिन् अन्तरे क्रूरो भ्रातरौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥३-६९-४२॥
verses.transliteration: mā sma trāsam vṛthā vīra na hi tvā dṛk viṣīdati ।etasmin antare krūro bhrātarau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥3-69-42॥

translations.english: In the meanwhile the foremost of the demons, Kabandha, rumbling like thunder questioned the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana:

verses.sloka: तौ उवाच महाबाहुः कबन्धो दानव उत्तमः ।कौ युवाम् वृषभ स्कन्धौ महा खड्ग धनुर् धरौ ॥३-६९-४३॥
verses.transliteration: tau uvāca mahābāhuḥ kabandho dānava uttamaḥ ।kau yuvām vṛṣabha skandhau mahā khaḍga dhanur dharau ॥3-69-43॥

translations.english: Who are you with bulllike shoulders, wielding big swords, bows and arrows? By coming to this place you have become my food.

verses.sloka: घोरम् देशम् इमम् प्राप्तौ दैवेन मम चाक्षुषौ ।वदतम् कार्यम् इह वाम् किम् अर्थम् च आगतौ युवाम् ॥३-६९-४४॥
verses.transliteration: ghoram deśam imam prāptau daivena mama cākṣuṣau ।vadatam kāryam iha vām kim artham ca āgatau yuvām ॥3-69-44॥

translations.english: For what purpose have you come? What work have you here ? You have come at the right time as my food, since I am hungry.

verses.sloka: इमम् देशम् अनुप्राप्तौ क्षुधा आर्तस्य इह तिष्ठतः ।स बाण चाप खड्गौ च तीक्ष्ण शृंगौ इव ऋषभौ ॥३-६९-४५॥
verses.transliteration: imam deśam anuprāptau kṣudhā ārtasya iha tiṣṭhataḥ ।sa bāṇa cāpa khaḍgau ca tīkṣṇa śṛṁgau iva ṛṣabhau ॥3-69-45॥

translations.english: Holding bows, arrows and swords, looking like bulls with pointed horns you have entered my mouth. It is impossible for you to live any more.

verses.sloka: मम तूर्णम् उपसंप्राप्तौ दुर्लभम् जीवितम् वाम् ।तस्य तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा कबंधस्य दुरात्मनः ॥३-६९-४६॥
verses.transliteration: mama tūrṇam upasaṁprāptau durlabham jīvitam vām ।tasya tat vacanam śrutvā kabaṁdhasya durātmanaḥ ॥3-69-46॥

translations.english: On hearing the words of the evilminded Kabandha, Rama said to Lakshmana with dried up mouth:

verses.sloka: उवाच लक्ष्मणम् रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता ।कृच्छ्रात् कृच्छ्रतरम् प्राप्य दारुणम् सत्य विक्रम ॥३-६९-४७॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca lakṣmaṇam rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā ।kṛcchrāt kṛcchrataram prāpya dāruṇam satya vikrama ॥3-69-47॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, your valour is truth.We have gone through from one calamity to a greater one without finding the beloved Sita. Now we have landed into a terrible crisis which will put an end to our own life.

verses.sloka: व्यसनम् जीवित अन्ताय प्राप्तम् अप्राप्य ताम् प्रियाम् ।कालस्य सुमहत् वीर्यम् सर्व भूतेषु लक्ष्मण ॥३-६९-४८॥
verses.transliteration: vyasanam jīvita antāya prāptam aprāpya tām priyām ।kālasya sumahat vīryam sarva bhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa ॥3-69-48॥

translations.english: O tiger among men see how powerful the might of time is for all beings Just see yourself and myself afflicted wth this great calamity.

verses.sloka: त्वाम् च माम् च नरव्याघ्र व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितौ ।न हि भारो अस्ति दैवस्य सर्व भुतेषु लक्ष्मण ॥३-६९-४९॥
verses.transliteration: tvām ca mām ca naravyāghra vyasanaiḥ paśya mohitau ।na hi bhāro asti daivasya sarva bhuteṣu lakṣmaṇa ॥3-69-49॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana look at the power of time over all creatures There is nothing too heavy for time. Even those who know the use of arms in war, or are brave or strong enough, cannot withstand the force of time like the barriers built with sand.

verses.sloka: शूराः च बलवंतः च कृत अस्त्राः च रण आजिरे ।काल अभिपन्नाः सीदन्ति यथा वालुक सेतवः ॥३-६९-५०॥
verses.transliteration: śūrāḥ ca balavaṁtaḥ ca kṛta astrāḥ ca raṇa ājire ।kāla abhipannāḥ sīdanti yathā vāluka setavaḥ ॥3-69-50॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana look at the power of time over all creatures There is nothing too heavy for time. Even those who know the use of arms in war, or are brave or strong enough, cannot withstand the force of time like the barriers built with sand.

verses.sloka: इति ब्रुवाणो दृढ सत्य विक्रमोमहायशा दाशरथिः प्रतापवान् ।अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिम् उदग्र विक्रमम्स्थिराम् तदा स्वाम् मतिम् आत्मना अकरोत् ॥३-६९-५१॥
verses.transliteration: iti bruvāṇo dṛḍha satya vikramomahāyaśā dāśarathiḥ pratāpavān ।avekṣya saumitrim udagra vikramamsthirām tadā svām matim ātmanā akarot ॥3-69-51॥

translations.english: Firm in the strength of truth, famous and powerful Rama, son of Dasaratha, determined to act with a steadfast mind, spoke to Lakshmana of mighty manliness on seeing him. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
